Tooltip_craft_YoghurtIncubatorDesc: A Yoghurt Pot wrapped in cloth. Pour in milk hot from the stove and add a yoghurt or a starter; it sets by itself once the milk has cooled to 45 C.
Tooltip_craft_StarterCultureCrockDesc: A clay jar or pot under a cloth, for growing a yoghurt starter from wheat and milk when no yoghurt is left to start from.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Yog: A wide lidded pot that holds 5 litres. Wrap it in cloth to build a Yoghurt Incubator.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Jar: A litre of home-set yoghurt: four cups. Right-click to spoon it into Empty Yoghurt Containers, one at a time or all at once; the jar comes back with the last cup.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Act: A live culture grown on wheat. Add it to a Yoghurt Incubator to set one batch.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Emp: Wash it and fill it again with home-set yoghurt.
